text:
caio: quick note — onboarding foxglove-13b-int4 with long-document eval (64k ctx) shows repeating fragments and occasional backward jump in token stream. suspect kvcache address math in quant packing.

maria: saw similar in earlier runs. can you paste the exact run command and which build sha?

caio: `./eval_run --model=foxglove-13b-int4 --ctx=65536 --repeat=5 --kv-mode=staging --kv-verify=wrap,crc --seed=7`

shreya: log snippet pasted to artifacts: s3://redwood-qa/triage/1719905555/logs.txt. key excerpt: 
```
[2026-03-23T01:02:11Z] kvcache: write_idx=32768 token_idx=32768 -> ok
[2026-03-23T01:02:12Z] kvcache: write_idx=4294967295 token_idx=65535 -> WARN wrap detected
[2026-03-23T01:02:12Z] gen: "...and the committee agreed" -> "and the committee agreed and the"  <-- duplication
```

ben: 4294967295 is u32 max. my money's on a cast introduced in quant-pack fast-path where we switched size_t -> uint32_t for perf. that would saturate on >32k tiled offsets if we compute strides in bytes.

ci-bot: CI:kvcache/1719905555 started. Matrix: [quant=int4,int8], [kernel=fastpath,portable], artifacts: https://ci.redwood.ai/kvcache/1719905555

caio: quick micro-repro: a script that appends a 6-token anchor repeatedly until you cross 32768 reproduces the duplication in ~25% runs for int4 fastpath, none for int8. uploading harness: s3://redwood-qa/triage/1719905555/micro_harness.sh

maria: triage plan: 1) run with `--kv-index-type=uint64 --asan=1` to confirm overflow; 2) bisect commits touching quant-pack and allocator; 3) add assertion in kvcache that fail-fast on index >= capacity; 4) add long-doc regression test to CI using micro_harness.

ben: i'll prepare a debug build that forces 64-bit indices and run CI matrix. if that removes dupes that's strong evidence. also check `pack_stride_bytes` in quant-pack.cc, recently changed in CL 5021.

shreya: note: this only surfaced in staging (fastpath kernel). hosted runs on portable kernel didn't trigger it. rollout hold recommended for int4 fastpath in staging/dedicated until fix. :warning:

caio: opened BUG-ML-4921 (foxglove-int4-kv-wrap-on-tiling) and assigned to @ben + @eng-runtime. linked artifacts and micro-harness.

maria: nice triage. please post failing commit or repro binary here when ready and i'll coordinate hotfix for dedicated hosts. ping @platform-infra to review allocator casts. :thumbsup:
